arxiv-1909-09389.title: Sampling Bias in Deep Active Classification: An Empirical Study
arxiv-1909-09389.creator: Ameya Prabhu, Charles Dognin, Maneesh Singh, University of Oxford, Verisk | | AI, Verisk Analyticsameya.prabhu@eng.ox.ac.uk, {charles.dognin, maneesh.singh}@verisk.com
arxiv-1909-09389.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Ameya Prabhu, Charles Dognin, Maneesh Singh, University of Oxford, Verisk | | AI, Verisk Analyticsameya.prabhu@eng.ox.ac.uk, {charles.dognin, maneesh.singh}@verisk.com. The exploding cost and time needed for data labeling and model training are bottlenecks for training DNN models on large datasets. Identifying smaller representative data samples with strategies like active learning can help mitigate such bottlenecks. Previous works on active learning in NLP identify the problem of sampling bias in the samples acquired by uncertainty-based querying and develop costly approaches to address it.

arxiv-2310-14269.creator: D. V. Chubukov, I. A. Aleksandrov, L. V. Skripnikov, A. N. Petrov
arxiv-2310-14269.description: Abstract We investigate the process of photon absorption by atoms or molecules shortly interacting with a laser beam in the dipole approximation. Assuming that the interaction time τ \tau is much smaller than the lifetime of the corresponding excited state, we examine the absorption probability as a function of τ \tau .

arxiv-2407-10330.description: Abstract We introduce Tree-D Fusion , featuring the first collection of 600,000 environmentally aware, 3D simulation-ready tree models generated through Diffusion priors. arxiv-2508-01477.title: The seeds of the future are in the present: A blind exploration of metastable states
arxiv-2508-01477.creator: Timothée Devergne, Vladimir Kostic, Massimiliano Pontil, Michele Parrinello
arxiv-2508-01477.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Timothée Devergne, Vladimir Kostic, Massimiliano Pontil, Michele Parrinello. In this work, we present a novel type of molecular dynamics simulation that aims at discovering, in a blind way, new metastable states. Using only data coming from an initial unbiased simulation, and with the help an appropriately defined loss function, we compute a bias that favors sampling yet unexplored configurational space regions, encouraging the system to leave the initial basin.

pmc-11353211.title: The Impact of Maternal Nanoplastic and Microplastic Particle Exposure on Mammal’s Offspring
pmc-11353211.creator: Hong-Ren Yu, Jiunn-Ming Sheen, Mao-Meng Tiao, Paola Piomboni, Alice Luddi, Melvin K S Leow
pmc-11353211.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The issue of environmental nanoplastic (NPl) particle and microplastic (MPl) particle pollution is becoming increasingly severe, significantly impacting ecosystems and biological health. Research shows that NPl/MPl can penetrate the placental barrier and enter the fetus, leading to transgenerational effects. This review integrates the existing literature on the effects of prenatal NPl/MPl exposure on mammalian offspring, focusing particularly on its negative impacts on the central nervous system, liver, intestinal health, reproductive function, and skeletal muscles.

pmc-12629247.creator: Jiumei He, Longyan Yao, Na Lan, Li Zhu, Yongmei Lv
pmc-12629247.description: BackgroundAlopecia areata (AA) is an autoimmune-mediated, non-scarring hair loss disorder. With the advancement of alopecia treatment research, the efficacy of Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitors in the clinical management of AA has been increasingly evaluated.ObjectiveThis study reports the efficacy and safety of tofacitinib in the treatment of severe AA and presents a literature review on tofacitinib in AA.

pmc-13066094.title: Advancing medical AI through benchmarking and competition for specialty triage
pmc-13066094.creator: Chao Ding, Mouxiao Bian, Minjia Yuan, Luyi Jiang, Kaiyi Luo, Pengcheng Chen, Yuanye Jiang, Jie Xu
pmc-13066094.description: Artificial intelligence holds transformative potential for clinical triage, yet challenges in accuracy, generalization, and interpretability persist. To address these gaps, we introduce MedTriage, a benchmark designed to evaluate large-scale models across diverse clinical scenarios rigorously. Leveraging this framework, we launched the Large-Model-Based Medical Triage Evaluation Competition, utilizing real-world clinician-patient dialogues from general hospitals and four specialized domains.

pmc-13185375.description: Clinical practice guidelines recommend team outpatient eating disorder treatment, yet the organisation and delivery of team care vary considerably in practice. pmc-13226874.description: BackgroundColorectal cancer (CRC) is highly heterogeneous, which limits the consistency of benefit from immune checkpoint blockade. pmc-13408999.title: Clinical significance of gut microbiota-derived metabolite trimethylamine N-oxide in patients with systemic lupus erythematosus

pmc-13408999.description: Trimethylamine N-oxide (TMAO), a gut microbiota-derived metabolite, is associated with cardiovascular disease (CVD) via pro-inflammatory and pro-atherogenic mechanisms. pmc-13682120.creator: Alemu Tesfahun Fida, Mirgissa Kaba, Alemayehu Worku
pmc-13682120.description: BackgroundThe Ethiopian military implements health promotion interventions to improve and maintain fitness, health, and military readiness.
